titlePlain: Building the CI/CD Pipeline: Lint, Test, and
subtitle: Video 13 of 20 · Fairmont Grain Co-op: The Data That Went Quiet During Harvest

eyebrow: One path, not three manual ones

steps.label: validate (every PR)
steps.sub: helm lint, schema check, terraform plan

steps.label: deploy (merge to main only)
steps.sub: terraform apply, then helm upgrade, gated by a human reviewer

steps.label: remote state lock
steps.sub: Azure Storage blob lease blocks a concurrent apply

code:
deploy:
  needs: validate
  if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
  environment: production
  steps:
    - run: terraform apply -auto-approve
    - run: |
        helm upgrade --install grain-ingest charts/grain-ingest \
          --namespace grain --atomic --timeout 5m
caption: Infra lands first, then the workload -- never the other way around.

eyebrow: What this pipeline does NOT catch yet
code:
CATCHES:
  malformed chart syntax, bad K8s schema, bad terraform plan

DOES NOT CATCH:
  a resource applied outside this repo (kubectl apply by hand)
  two manifests whose label selectors silently disagree
caption: That second list is exactly the gap the harvest incident walks into.
